questions.question: How many layers does the OSI model have?
How many layers are there in the TCP/IP model?
questions.hint: not as many as the OSI model.

questions.question: True or False: Routers operate at layer 2 of the OSI model?
What addressing mechanism is used at the Link Layer of the TCP/IP model?
questions.hint: Its not IP. Write it as singular not plural. Format XXX-YYYYYYY

questions.question: At what layer of the OSI model is a PDU encapsulated into a packet? ( the number )
What addressing mechanism utilizes a 32-bit address?
questions.hint: The only one not represented in hexadecimal format.

questions.question: What Transport layer protocol is connection oriented?
questions.hint: considered reliable, makes connections between source and destination.

questions.question: What Transport Layer protocol is considered unreliable?
questions.hint: Fire and Forget, it doesn't care about your data.

questions.question: TCP's three-way handshake consists of 3 packets: 1.Syn, 2.Syn & ACK, 3. _? What is the final packet of the handshake?
questions.hint: the session establishment must be ACKnowledged by both server and host.
